label: Двое – Четверо
description: A 10-sentence card for collective numerals two through four.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Collective with genitive plural. 'Двое' is a collective numeral that governs the genitive plural, so 'детей' stands in the genitive plural rather than the usual count form.
Strategic focus: Collective with people. 'Трое' governs the genitive plural 'друзей'; collective numerals are preferred with groups of people, and the verb takes the plural.
Strategic focus: Collective subject. 'Четверо' requires the genitive plural 'студентов'; as a subject of people it pairs naturally with the plural verb 'сдали'.
Strategic focus: Pluralia tantum. With nouns that exist only in the plural, like 'сутки', collectives are obligatory; 'четверо' governs the genitive plural 'суток'.
Strategic focus: Young animals. Collectives may count young animals; 'трое' governs the genitive plural 'котят', and the plural verb 'спали' agrees with the group.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural government. 'Двое' takes the genitive plural 'мужчин'; collectives are common with male persons, with the verb in the plural.
Strategic focus: Collective with workers. 'Четверо' governs the genitive plural 'рабочих'; the collective foregrounds the group acting together with a plural verb.
Strategic focus: Informal group. 'Трое' governs the genitive plural 'ребят'; this collective is typical of colloquial counting of young people.
Strategic focus: Pluralia tantum object. With plural-only 'ножницы' a collective is required; 'двое' governs the genitive plural 'ножниц' as a direct object.
Strategic focus: Collective with soldiers. 'Четверо' governs the genitive plural 'солдат'; the collective is standard for male persons acting as a unit.
